China holds the global record with the Danyang–Kunshan Grand Bridge. Stretching across Jiangsu Province, this #bridge supports bullet trains traveling at speeds of up to 300 km/h.

Thailand’s Bang Na Expressway is the world’s longest car bridge, elevating #traffic over one of Asia’s most congested cities, turning airspace into a strategic transport corridor.

The Metro Manila Skyway in the Philippines provides a critical high-speed artery above gridlocked streets, reshaping urban mobility. 

Similarly, the Metro Manila Skyway in the Philippines provides a critical high-speed artery above gridlocked streets, reshaping urban mobility.

In the Gulf, the King Fahd Causeway has, since 1986, physically and economically linked Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. Its 25 km of reinforced infrastructure that supports a steady flow of commerce, tourism, and strategic movement across the Arabian Gulf.

Source: MASTT, Government of Bahrain
